modules.name: Cabinet IR
modules.purpose: Convolves the signal with a cabinet or speaker impulse response, with low and high cut filters; the speaker half of an amp capture.

modules.name: BlueAmp
modules.purpose: Guitarix model of a clean to slightly breaking-up blues amp. Warm, dynamic and open; push master for edge. The clean guitar sound. Follow with gx_ultracab.

modules.name: Guvnor
modules.purpose: Guitarix model of a classic overdrive/distortion pedal with gain, level and a three-band tone control. Place it BEFORE an amp (gx_blueamp, gx_plexi or gx_supersonic) to push it, or use it alone before gx_ultracab for a fuzzy lo-fi sound.

modules.name: Plexi
modules.purpose: Guitarix model of a classic 1960s-70s British plexi head: crunchy, mid-forward classic rock, from edge of breakup to hard rock when pushed. Follow with gx_ultracab.

modules.name: Supersonic
modules.purpose: Guitarix model of a modern high-gain amp: tight, aggressive distortion with gain, bass and treble. The high-gain guitar sound for rock and metal. Follow with gx_ultracab.

modules.name: UltraCab
modules.purpose: Guitarix speaker-cabinet simulation (stereo) with built-in microphoned cab sound and controls for the character of the box. Always put it AFTER the amp: an amp without a cabinet sounds thin and fizzy.

modules.name: NAM Amp
modules.purpose: Neural capture of a real guitar amp, pedal or bass rig, played through Neural Amp Modeler, with a noise gate and bass/mid/treble tone stack around it.

modules.name: Air2
modules.purpose: Treble exciter: three boost bands (hiss, glitter, air) plus a Silk control that adds soft harmonics to the highs; adds sparkle EQ cannot.

modules.name: Channel9
modules.purpose: Mixing-desk channel: choose a Neve, API, SSL, Teac or Mackie voicing with drive; a more coloured console option than Console8.

modules.name: Console8
modules.purpose: Console-channel colour: subtle analog-style texture (defined lows, softened top, solid depth) as if through a good desk; raise Drive for smooth saturation. A 'secret sauce' late in a vocal chain, before reverb.

modules.name: Density
modules.purpose: Smooth sine-shaped saturation that fattens and pushes a sound forward; negative settings thin it and push it back. A highpass keeps the fattening out of the lows.

modules.name: TapeMachine 2
modules.purpose: Analog tape emulation adding saturation, head bump, gentle compression and optional wow and flutter; Swiss deck for tracking and mix colour, American deck for mastering.

modules.name: Tube2
modules.purpose: Tube-style saturation: warm even harmonics and soft clipping with an input trim; a rounder, thicker alternative to Console8 or tape.

modules.name: ChorusEnsemble
modules.purpose: Multi-tap chorus with a lush, textured sound that sits well away from the original; thickens pads, backing vocals and guitars, and doubles a vocal when blended low.

modules.name: Clean Delay
modules.purpose: Clean, uncoloured stereo or ping-pong echo with filtered feedback and an optional ducker; for slapback, vocal throws, rhythmic echoes and ambience that must stay out of the way.

modules.name: Tape Echo
modules.purpose: Roland Space Echo style tape delay with three playback heads and a spring reverb: warm, dark, slightly wobbly echoes that get softer and smudgier with each repeat; classic for vocal throws, dub, rockabilly slapback and psychedelic guitar.

modules.name: Drum Sampler
modules.purpose: SFZ sample player that turns MIDI from the DAW into drum sounds from a chosen kit; the sound source for the software drums chain.

modules.name: ButterComp2
modules.purpose: Smooth, glue-style compressor with a soft, musical, almost un-compressor-like feel: it thickens and evens out vocals, bass, guitars and buses without pumping or obvious grabbing. One Compress knob, plus output and dry/wet for parallel use.

modules.name: DeBess
modules.purpose: De-esser that detects 's' sounds by their waveform rather than a frequency band, so it reduces sibilance while leaving the rest of the treble untouched.

modules.name: Multi-Comp
modules.purpose: Compressor with seven hardware-style modes (opto, FET, VCA, bus, studio FET, studio VCA, digital) for levelling vocals, adding punch to drums and gluing buses.

modules.name: Console EQ
modules.purpose: British console-style channel EQ: high-pass and low-pass filters plus four bands (two shelving or bell, two sweepable mids) with musical, slightly coloured curves.

modules.name: Parametric EQ (8-band)
modules.purpose: Eight-band parametric EQ for high-pass and low-pass filtering, corrective cuts (mud, boxiness, harshness) and broad tonal shaping.

modules.name: Peak Limiter
modules.purpose: Transparent lookahead peak limiter with true-peak detection; the final safety stage that holds the output under the ceiling.

modules.name: Hall Reverb
modules.purpose: Concert-hall reverb with early reflections and a long, smooth, modulated tail; for big, spacious, expansive vocals, pads and ballads.

modules.name: Plate Reverb
modules.purpose: Plate reverb for bright, dense ambience; the classic choice for lead vocals and snare.

modules.name: Room Reverb
modules.purpose: Room reverb with clear early reflections and a short to medium natural tail; puts a dry vocal or instrument in a believable space.

modules.name: Srsly2
modules.purpose: Psychoacoustic stereo widener in the style of the Hughes SRS: narrow boosts and cuts on the mid and side signals create a wide, holographic image. Can go from subtle spatial depth to extreme width.

modules.name: SweetWide
modules.purpose: Grungy stereo widener built from ring-modulation ideas: exaggerates the side signal with a gnarly, compressed character. Also narrows the image when turned the other way. A secret-weapon colour effect, not a transparent widener.
